_note: What you see: the first-visit tour over the dashboard: the welcome card Welcome to Dossiq, the six steps with their tasks (Click All cases in the menu; Open Advanced, then Case types) and the All cases step as a pointer at the menu.
_title_nl: dossiq: rondleiding bij het eerste bezoek
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: de rondleiding bij het eerste bezoek over het dashboard: de welkomstkaart Welkom bij Dossiq, de zes stappen met hun taken (Klik op Alle zaken in het menu; Open Geavanceerd, daarna Zaaktypen) en de stap Alle zaken als aanwijzer bij het menu.
oktober 2026, alle teams waar u in zit: October 2026, all teams you are in
uw eigen indeling van de widgets wordt b: your own arrangement of the widgets is kept; anyone who has not moved anything sees the arrangement the manifest ships
haalden hun termijn, naar doorlooptijd: met their deadline, by lead time
Zeven dagen of langer zonder update, lan: Seven days or longer without an update, longest first. Bezwaar omgevingsvergunning, updated three days ago, is not listed. Without such cases the card reads: No stalled cases.
Zaken en taken, eerst wat het eerst moet: Cases and tasks, soonest due first
na zes regels telt de kaart de rest: after six rows the card counts the rest
Opgepakt door niemand, in de teams waar: Picked up by nobody, in the teams you are in
De zaak van team Toezicht staat er niet:: The case of team Toezicht is not listed: you are not in that team. If you are in no team, the card reads: you are in no team, ask your administrator, and requests nothing.
Te laat, en minder dan een kwart van de: Overdue, and less than a quarter of the deadline left
Minste dagen eerst. Een zaak met 5 dagen: Fewest days first. A case with 5 of 56 days left is not listed. The bar is the time consumed.
Taken die vandaag of binnen drie dagen m: Tasks due today or within three days
Advies vragen aan Mobiliteit en verkeer: Request advice from Mobility and traffic
Te laat bovenaan, meeste dagen eerst; da: Overdue on top, most days first; then by date. A task due in five days is not listed. Without tasks the card reads: No task reminders.
Alle lopende Woo-verzoeken op dagen tot: Every open Woo request by days to the decision date, fewest first
Rood: te laat. Oranje: twee dagen of min: Red: overdue. Orange: two days or less. Yellow: a week or less. Green: on track. The requester is shown when known.
Binnen termijn ziet alleen wie controlee: Only reviewers and administrators see Within deadline. A widget whose role you do not hold is not shown, not even as an empty slot, and the page does not send its data. If a role resolves to nobody, the widget disappears and the log names the widget and the role.
dezelfde twee widgets, te kiezen onder A: the same two widgets, selectable under Customize on the Nextcloud dashboard; the header opens this dashboard, a task opens the task in Dossiq
Een korte rondleiding langs het menu. He: A short tour of the menu. It takes less than a minute. The tour starts only here, on the dashboard; whoever arrives on a case through a link sees that case without a welcome card and gets the tour on their first visit to the dashboard. Restart it later from Help and explanation.
De zes stappen van de rondleiding: The six steps of the tour
Stap 2 tot en met 6 zijn taken: de stap: Steps 2 to 6 are tasks: the step only continues when you open the page. Every task names the menu item by the label it carries in the menu; when it sits under Advanced, the task says to open Advanced first. The text says only what the page shows: no number of case types, and at All cases the open cases in your teams, not every case.
Een korte rondleiding langs het menu. Kn: A short tour of the menu. Button Next.
Uw teams in één oogopslag: termijnen, wa: Your teams at a glance: deadlines, queue and alerts. Task: Click Dashboard in the menu.
De open zaken in uw teams. Taak: Klik op: The open cases in your teams. Task: Click All cases in the menu.
Wat op uw naam staat, op deadline. Taak:: What is in your name, by due date. Task: Click Tasks in the menu.
De zaaktypen waarmee uw organisatie werk: The case types your organisation works with; the administrator sets them up here. Task: Open Advanced, then Case types.
Terug naar het dashboard, uw startpunt e: Back to the dashboard, your starting point every day. Task: Click Dashboard in the menu.
Open Alle zaken: de open zaken in uw tea: Open All cases: the open cases in your teams, sorted by deadline.
Klik op Alle zaken in het menu: Click All cases in the menu
